text: Bhai, system galat bata raha hai. Delivery boy abhi abhi deke gaya hai box. Poora dabbe ki halat kharab thi, andar se kach-kach ki aawaz aa rahi thi saaf, aur maine kholne se pehle photo bhi khich li thi. Mera crockery set tha isme, 2199 ka. Ab isko replace karo ya mere paise wapas karo yaar.
